critic.fix_suggestion: Duplicate the engine geometry on the opposite wing to achieve a 2x count (4 total). For each set, apply a translation of +15% along the X-axis (outward) and -10% along the Z-axis (forward) from the fuselage root. Additionally, detach engines from the fuselage junction and mount them onto pylons extending 20% forward from the wing's leading edge to ensure proper distribution.
